subject.title: lossless-claw bootstraps into quarantine after every Gateway restart due to new sessionId generating fresh JSONL file

question: Should OpenClaw accept an opt-in `session.restartContinuation` config for aborted main-session id continuity across Gateway restarts, now that current main already separately reuses successful `done` rows?
rationale: The remaining behavior is compatibility-sensitive session lifecycle policy and a new config surface, not a purely mechanical code repair; the open PR is coherent but still needs maintainer sponsorship or rejection.

options.title: Sponsor the opt-in PR
options.body: Review and land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/94567 if maintainers want explicit operator-controlled aborted-session id preservation.

options.title: Choose a config-free recovery path
options.body: Keep the issue open but ask for a narrower restart-recovery design that avoids adding `session.restartContinuation`.

options.title: Reject the direction
options.body: Close the linked PR and this issue if maintainers decide abnormal restart rows should keep rotating instead of preserving the session id.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the opt-in PR
recommendation.body: Review and land https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/94567 if maintainers want explicit operator-controlled aborted-session id preservation.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest available routing candidate from prior terminal-main transcript reconciliation history and the linked PR review context.
